55   RELATED PARTY DISCLOSURE
The Bank has carried out transactions in the ordinary course of business with parties who are defined as “Related Parties” as
defined in LKAS 24 - ‘Related Party Disclosures’. The terms and conditions of such transactions are disclosed under Note 55.4
and Note 55.5.
55.1   Parent and Ultimate Controlling Party
The Bank does not have an identifiable parent of its own.
